optimizedDescription.value: Lightweight ChangeRepository.list* row shapes: shared base plus draft/discard extras; detail stays on get*.

optimizedContext.value:
# ChangeListEntry

## Rules
- Shared base required: `name`, `createdAt`, `state` (from history), `specIds`, `schemaName`, `schemaVersion`.
- `ActiveChangeListEntry`: base only; optional `description` iff `includeDescription`.
- `DraftedChangeListEntry`: + required `draftedAt`, `draftedBy` (history); optional `description`/`reason` via include flags.
- `DiscardedChangeListEntry`: + required `discardedAt`, `discardedBy`; optional `description`/`reason`/`supersededBy` via include flags.
- Three distinct types — MUST NOT be single discriminated union at port layer.
- MUST NOT include history, artifact maps, hashes, approvals, content (detail ops only).

## Constraints
- Read-only data shapes; no mutators.
- Optional fields only when matching include* set; flags = response projection — index holds full payload; no extra get/file reads.
- History-derived fields projected at build time, not opaque manifest snapshots.
